SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--LINKMYROWDATA --LINKDETAILLIST(KEEWAYZUP4010X,700,{0},{1}) DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = '#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#'; DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(5)='{0}'; --ZUPK DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(50)='{1}'; --MFGZUPK25110003 DECLARE @ITMREF VARCHAR(30)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @ITMDES VARCHAR(30)=N'%{3}%'; DECLARE @LOC VARCHAR(30)='%{4}%';
SELECT M.MFGFCY_0 AS 地点 ,M.MFGNUM_0 AS 工单号 ,M.BOMSEQ_0 AS 物料行 ,M.ITMREF_0 AS 产品编码 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, I.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, I.ITMDES2_0) AS 产品描述2 ,Cast(M.RETQTY_0 AS REAL) AS 计划数量 ,Cast(Isnull(X.YQTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 已退数量 ,Cast(Isnull(X.XQTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 未提交数 ,Cast(M.RETQTY_0 - Isnull(X.QTY, 0) AS REAL) AS 可退数量 ,I.STU_0 AS 单位 ,M.MFGNUM_0 + Cast(M.BOMSEQ_0 AS VARCHAR) id ,M.LOC_0 AS 库位 ,CASE WHEN Isnull(X.XQTY, 0) > 0 THEN 'E02' ELSE 'B01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR2 ,CASE WHEN X.VCRNUM_0 IS NOT NULL THEN 'mui-active' ELSE '' END AS ROWACTIVE ,CASE WHEN I.LOTMGTCOD_0 > 1 THEN N'lang:{zh:批次号管理,en:Batch Management,de:Chargenverwaltung}' ELSE '' END LOTFLG ,CASE WHEN SERMGTCOD_0 >1 THEN N'lang:{zh:序列号管理,en:Serial Number Management,de:Seriennummernverwaltung}' ELSE '' END SERFLG FROM MFGMAT M INNER JOIN ITMMASTER I ON M.ITMREF_0 = I.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = I.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = I.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT Sum(Iif(RPFLG_0 = 3, QTYSTU_0, 0)) YQTY ,Sum(Iif(RPFLG_0 <> 3, QTYSTU_0, 0)) XQTY ,Sum(QTYSTU_0) QTY ,VCRNUM_0 ,VCRLIN_0 FROM XWSSCS WHERE TRSFAM_0 = 'MFGR' AND VCRNUM_0 = @MFGNUM GROUP BY VCRNUM_0 ,VCRLIN_0) X ON X.VCRNUM_0 = M.MFGNUM_0 AND X.VCRLIN_0 = M.BOMSEQ_0 WHERE M.MFGFCY_0 = @FCY AND M.MFGNUM_0 = @MFGNUM AND M.ITMREF_0 LIKE Upper(@ITMREF) AND Upper(ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, I.ITMDES1_0)+ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, I.ITMDES2_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITMDES) AND M.LOC_0 LIKE @LOC ORDER BY M.MFGLIN_0 ,M.BOMSEQ_0
